applicability.quote: P2008 JC aeroplanes, serial numbers 1002 to 1085 inclusive.

parsed.compliance_time_text: Within 25 flight hours, or 25 flight cycles, or within 6 months, whichever occurs first after the effective date of this AD, accomplish a visual inspection of the firewall in accordance with the instructions of the SB. If any patch is found installed without screws, before next flight, remove and re-install the affected patch(es).
